summary: ICICI Bank Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing under Indian Listing Regulations that the presentation made at its 32nd Annual General Meeting by the Managing Director and CEO, Sandeep Bakhshi, is accessible via a link. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer report providing a link to an AGM presentation, with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or capital action. No deal terms, transactions, or board recommendations are disclosed. This is a standard corporate communication and does not constitute a special situation.
